method: cad.inspect exact measurements, collision and bounding boxes; cad.look visual review; source parameter and placement consistency checks

views: liner and tray with shade hidden
visual_review.finding: Four separate parts. Circular tray has no projecting ears; handle feet jog inward to tray sockets. Straight lamp cup and integral slotted tube replace the conical pedestal, stacked flanges and three-post frame. Shade underside shows three magnet pockets and an open wire recess. One necessary shade magnet ring remains. Hidden construction is a design default, not a photographed fact.

limits: No physical printing or fit trial performed.
Shade wall is nominally radial 1.8 mm, with fluted inner and outer profiles; normal wall thickness is not certified uniform.
Magnet holding force, adhesive durability, light temperature and translucency require a physical prototype.
Original lamp electrical ratings and connector identity are not provided; retain original wiring and matched supply.
